description: Run the bounded fixed-suite evaluation for an accessible declarative response-contract proposal and record its receipt; it does not execute arbitrary code/prompts or deploy. Requires authenticated access and proposal/baseline/candidate identifiers. Use propose_protocol_upgrade first. Unsupported candidates, version mismatches or unavailable suite evidence do not pass; retain the returned inconclusive/blocked status.

baseline_version.description: Required baseline version identifier; the evaluator checks it against the active fixed baseline.

candidate_version.description: Required candidate version/hash identifier; it must match the stored candidate.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable key, 8–160 characters, for retry-safe evaluation receipt.

proposal_id.description: Required accessible proposal ID previously returned by propose_protocol_upgrade.

suite_version.description: Optional fixed evaluation suite version; defaults to cassie-contract-1, and unsupported versions are inconclusive.

name: evaluate_protocol_upgrade
title: Evaluate a protocol upgrade
